scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2504_0: *Ai avut din nou ne voie de&ajutor cu temele?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2505_0: \E4&*Stiu ca ai avut probleme&ultima data^1,/\E4deci^1, um,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2509_0: \E4&*Ne pare rau^1, Kris^1, va&voi ajuta mai tarziu^1,/\E4daca este in regula./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2535_0: \E3*... Umm^1, Kris^1? Pot sa in&treb ceva^1, daca este in&regula?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2536_0: \E4&*Susie..^1. Sunt cam..^1. cu&rioasa cum este ea^1,/\E4stii?/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2590_0: \E6*... Doamne^1, atunci poate&ar trebui sa in cerc sa&vorbesc cu/\E6ea.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2591_0: \E8&*B-dar daca mor^1, tu&platesti pentru/\E8inmormantarea mea^1, Kris!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2592_0: \E6&*(Desi^1, si ncer^1, daca e&draguta^1, s-ar putea/\E6sa/\E6mor si eu^1...)/%

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2601_0: \E7&*Kris..^1. Imi pare foarte&rau ca trebuie/\E7sa treci/\E7prin asta./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2604_0: \E2&*Stii^1, asa ca nu ar&trebui sa fii cel^1,/\E2care^1,/\E2um,/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2613_0: \E3&*L-ca cand mi-ai spus ca&ICE-E este real si/\E3mananca copii.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2614_0: \E8&*Asa ca Dess te-a lovit&cu o bata pana/\E8cand ai/\E8incetat sa minti./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2618_0: \E4&*Si^1, crezi ca ii place&cel subtire sau cel/\E4gros...?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2619_0: \E8&*(Stai, poate sa-i faci o&cutie de pranz/\E8plina cu/\E8creta este o prostie...)/%
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2623_0: \E2&*Serios^1, Kris^1? Dar te&ajut tot ti mpul!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2624_0: \E8&*Cel mai putin pe care il&poti face este/\E8sa-mi dai/\E8PUTINE in formatii!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2629_0: \E4&*Ne pare rau, Kris^1, nu&este treaba mea^1, nu-i/\E4asa...?/

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2704_0: *CONSTRUIND O IN CHISOARE&IN IN TREAGA LUME^1. ACUM/SUNT SI NGURUL LIBER./

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2977_0: \E2&*Stiu ca vrei sa le iei&la revedere cu/\E2adevarat/\E2tuturor^1, nu?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2979_0: \E2&*Stii, ne-am putea in&toarce o secunda^1./\E2Daca/\E2ai vrut./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2992_0: \E9&*Sa ne luam macar la&revedere de la/\E9Lancer!/%
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3002_0: *Daca ma poti invinge^1, voi&reveni la a fi un tip bun./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3004_0: \E2&*VOI, baieti, va trebui&sa de veniti/\E2baieti rai/\E2cu noi.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3007_0: *Ho ho ho!!^1! Dorinta&noastra este comanda ta!!!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3037_0: \E9&*Intr-o zi, in curand,&vei pleca si la/\E9universitate.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3040_0: \E8&*Ai in trebat cand iti&vor creste coarnele?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3041_0: \E0&*Asa ca am cu mparat acea&banda pentru cap/\E0cu/\E0coarnele rosii pe ea./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3042_0: \E4&*Oh,^1, l-ai purtat luni de&zile! Ce sa/\E4intamplat cu/\E4el?/%
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3044_0: \E9&*Iti am intesti acel joc&video pe care tu/\E9si/\E9Asriel il jucati?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3046_0: \E0&*Cand era foarte mic,^1, ii&placea soparla/\E0verde din/\E0asta./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3047_0: \E9&*Am avut chiar si o pe&trecere de nastere/\E9pentru el tematica in/\E9jurul ei./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3048_0: \E0&*Tatal tau a pictat toate&aceste oua cu/\E0pete drept/\E0decor.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3050_0: \E5&*Pana a doua zi^1, tatal&tau le-a gatit pe/\E5toate/\E5la micul dejun./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3052_0: \E4&*Inca de la^1, a urat acea&carte despre/\E4consumul de/\E4oua verzi!/%
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3056_0: \E1&*Kris^1, de oarece doar tu&si eu locuim aici/\E1chiar/\E1acum.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3059_0: \E9&*este le acul perfect&pentru o as tfel de/\E9afectiune./
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3060_0: \E5*... atata timp cat pot&sa mananc niste^1, de&sigur./%
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3078_0: \E1&*Kris^1, poate ar trebui sa&te culci devreme/\E1in/\E1seara asta.../
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3143_0: *Este tortul meu^1, nu-i&asa!^1?/*L-ai reparat!^1?/*Il vei returna!?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3152_0: *Edamame^1! Vechiul meu tort^1!&Sunt atat de fericit ca&m-am/putut/in varti!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3153_0: *Prietenul meu^1,&impartaseste-mi bogatiile^1!&Am multe/prajituri mai rele pe care&nu le vreau!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3154_0: *Daca nu porti un Cake^1,&vino aici si iti dau unul^1!&Pentru/totdeauna!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3157_0: *Acum^1, voi continua sa ma&in vart si sa plang^1! In&varte si/plange!/%
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3162_0: *Dulce in tort^1, dar nu in&caracterul^1! O tragedie!!/%
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3174_0: *Mama miba^1! Cum va bucurati&de produsele mele de/patiserie/respinse?/%
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3178_0: *Mama prietena^1! Vrei un&tort in ferior^1, prietene?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3187_0: *Va rugam sa luati acest&tort^1! Nu are va loare^1,&dragul meu/prieten!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3192_0: *Mama shiba^1! Porti prea&multe lucruri care nu sunt/prajituri!/%
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3197_0: *Am in teles!^1! Prea multa&prajitura te va face sa te/in varti si/sa/plangi!!/%
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5007_0: *Vrei sa-mi iei tortul la o&in vartire?/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5008_0: *Ca noaptea si ziua^1, tortul&si lumea se in vart!/
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_5010_0: *Vino din nou in alta zi^1!&Haha hiha!/%
